title: e2e.rs test banner numbering is inconsistent — TLS regression test unnumbered
description: Tests 1-9 have numbered banners; spawn_test_listener_binds_loopback_port and peer_http_client_new_accepts_self_signed_cert have no number. Fix: assign sequential numbers (Test 10, Test 11) or drop numbering from all banners — function names are self-documenting.
